ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (as amended by Ley 70 de 2019); Decreto Ejecutivo No. 363 de 2015; Decreto Ejecutivo No. 129 de 2020 regarding the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales; supervised by the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) and the Superintendencia de Sujetos No Financieros (SSNF).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Copy of the Public Deed of Incorporation (Copia Autenticada de la Escritura Pública de Constitución)

Certified Copy of the Beneficial Ownership Filing (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (only if required by a foreign counterparty; domestic bank use does not require apostille)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the UAF national terrorism and money-laundering list, OFAC SDN list, UN consolidated sanctions list, EU consolidated sanctions list, Interpol red notices, and domestic PEP databases; enhanced due diligence (EDD) and source-of-funds verification are required for politically exposed persons, with continuous transaction monitoring and mandatory suspicious transaction reporting (STR) to the UAF within five business days of detection.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Servicio de Reserva de Nombre en Línea (Registro en Línea), accessible at www.registropublico.gob.pa
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be written in Latin characters; Spanish is the official language but English and other Latin-script languages are admissible without mandatory Spanish translation; non-Latin scripts require transliteration into Latin script; the name of a Sociedad Anónima must contain the suffix 'S.A.' or the full phrase 'Sociedad Anónima', and must be clearly distinct from any name already registered in the Registro Público de Panamá.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A rejected name may be re-filed immediately in the online portal as a new reservation with a distinct variant. For contested rejection, the applicant may file a written 'Recurso de Reconsideración' with the Registro Público within three business days of notification, followed by a 'Recurso de Apelación' within five business days before the Dirección General of the Registro Público under Ley 38 de 2000; exhaustion of these administrative remedies preserves the right to challenge the decision before the Sala Tercera de lo Contencioso Administrativo of the Corte Suprema de Justicia.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Acceptable for a non-licensed wholesale trading company. Panamanian law mandates only that the Sociedad Anónima continuously maintain a licensed Resident Agent with a physical office in Panama; the company itself may operate from a virtual office or a foreign administrative address, provided corporate books and records are accessible in Panama and the resident agent is able to receive service of process. The absence of local physical substance is tolerated for territorial-tax companies, but documentary substance (board minutes, contracts, trade finance files) should be consolidated in Panama to support the territorial-source treatment and OECD BEPS materiality analysis.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified low risk: approximately 5% per annum for a Low_Risk_Standard wholesale trading company with no local license and no local operations. Unannounced physical inspections are primarily directed at the licensed Resident Agent and its client files by the Superintendencia de Sujetos No Financieros (SSNF) and the UAF; direct inspections of client premises occur only upon specific AML risk triggers, suspicious transaction reports, or credible third-party complaints.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 32 of February 26, 1927 (Ley General de Sociedades / General Corporation Law of the Republic of Panama), as amended, particularly Articles 9 (mandatory contents of the incorporation instrument), 31 (capital stock), 64-67 (execution by public deed or private instrument), and 80 et seq. (directors and officers); complemented by Executive Decree No. 277 of December 2013 (digital procedures before the Registro Público) and the Tariff of Fees of the Public Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Public Registry of Panama) — Sección de Personas Jurídicas / Mercantil, Panama City.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Pacto Social y Estatutos de la Sociedad Anónima (Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws), executed as a notarized public deed (Escritura Pública) or private instrument, and inscribed in the Registro Público via the Formulario de Inscripción.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow/deposit account requirement. The articles must state an authorized capital (customarily US$ 10,000 represented by 10,000 shares of US$ 1.00 par value or no-par shares); the subscribed capital may be paid immediately, on demand of the Board, or according to the schedule fixed in the articles. Zero paid-up capital at formation is legally permitted.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME], S.A. The undersigned Board of Directors of the above-named Panamanian Sociedad Anónima, waiving notice, hereby resolve: 1. The subscription and allocation of the Company's common stock are ratified and accepted. 2. The registered office in Panama, maintained by the Resident Agent, is adopted. 3. The following officers are appointed: President, Secretary, and Treasurer, with full authority to execute banking, governmental, and commercial filings. 4. The corporate seal is adopted; issuance of share certificates is authorized. RESOLVED FURTHER, that all prior acts of the incorporators are ratified. Dated this ___ day of ________, 20___.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Name Reservation Service (Sistema de Reserva de Nombre) via the digital portal https://www.registropublico.gob.pa or the customer-service window.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two or three proposed corporate names (e.g., '[Proposed Name] S.A.') through the Registro Público's online name-reservation service or in person. Pay the non-refundable reservation fee and obtain the 'Certificado de Reserva de Nombre', valid for 30 calendar days, within which the incorporation instrument must be filed. Names containing 'Panama', 'Banco', 'Seguros', or governmental identifiers require prior authorization from the relevant state body.
required_dossiers: List of 2-3 proposed corporate names
Notarized petition or power of attorney (when filed by a licensed attorney)
Photocopy of the incorporator's passport or Panamanian cédula
Sworn statement that the requested name is not used by an existing entity (Registry format)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry returns a rejection on grounds of identical or confusingly similar existing name, promptly file a new electronic application with the next alternative name; the previously paid fee is not refundable, but the corrected reservation is processed within the ordinary 2-business-day SLA.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of the Incorporation Instrument (Pacto Social y Estatutos)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública (Notary Public) of the Republic of Panama, acting jointly with the incorporating Panamanian attorney.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the Panamanian attorney to draft the 'Pacto Social y Estatutos de la Sociedad Anónima' containing the corporate name, territorial purpose (including wholesale supply and logistics of drummed and bagged penetration-grade bitumen), authorized capital structure, term, directors, and the Resident Agent appointment. The incorporator/promoter signs the document before a Notary Public, who protocolizes it with the corresponding notary number, or the document may be executed as a private instrument under Law 32 of 1927 and later presented for registration. Verify that the reserved name and the resident agent information are correctly transcribed.
required_dossiers: Certificate of name reservation
Passport or cédula of the subscriber/incorporator
Details of the initial Board of Directors (name and address of each director)
Resident Agent (Residente Legal) appointment letter issued by a licensed Panamanian law firm
Statement of authorized and subscribed capital
Draft corporate purpose aligned with ISIC 4661
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies incomplete or inconsistent clauses, prepare and execute a corrective addendum (Aclaración) before protocolization; if the deficiency is found after notarization, a 'Fe de Erratas' or 'Escritura de Rectificación' must be executed and attached before filing at the Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription of the Corporation in the Public Registry of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección de Personas Jurídicas (Mercantile Section); e-filing via the Sede Electrónica / digital filing platform.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized incorporation deed, the registry application form (Formulario de Inscripción), the name-reservation certificate, and the fee payment receipts to the Sección de Personas Jurídicas. The Registry checks compliance with Law 32 of 1927 and issues the 'Inscripción' certificate together with the 'Ficha de Persona Jurídica' bearing the unique corporate identification number. Request a certified copy of the registered articles for use in banking and tax procedures. After inscription, the RUC and municipal Aviso de Operación processes may commence.
required_dossiers: Notarized Pacto Social y Estatutos (original and two copies)
Formulario de Inscripción signed by the petitioner
Certificate of name reservation
Proof of payment of the B/. 350 registration fee and stamp tax (Impuesto de Timbre)
Resident Agent acceptance and address (notarized)
Power of attorney (if filed by attorney)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues an 'objeción/defecto' notice, cure the defect by filing an 'Escritura de Reforma o Aclaración' and pay the corresponding re-registration fee within the term granted (generally 10 business days); upon cure, the inscription is completed and the priority date is preserved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer Registration (RUC) and Activation before the Directorate General of Revenue
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF) — Sede Electrónica / RUC online portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: With the Ficha de Persona Jurídica and certified articles, apply online for the Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC) and the corporate tax identification number. Select the tax classification corresponding to a private interest corporation engaged in wholesale fuel/bitumen distribution (Impuesto sobre la Renta, territorial regime, and ITBMS registration if the supply of goods occurs within Panama). Submit the sworn declaration of the registered office and, where the company expects to invoice offshore sales or logistics services, request the appropriate export/tax-credit certificate. Obtain the RUC certificate and the authorization for issuance of commercial invoices (pre-printed or electronic invoicing under the DGI 'facturación electrónica' system).
required_dossiers: Ficha de Persona Jurídica / certificate of Registry inscription
Certified copy of the registered articles
Notarized Resident Agent consent and address
Passport/cédula of directors, officers and legal representative
DGI application form (Formulario RUC) including ISIC 4661 activity code
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI queries the declared address or activity classification, file a corrective RUC form attaching the lease agreement or the Resident Agent's registered-office confirmation and the articles of incorporation; the DGI will lift the query upon consistent documentation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Aviso de Operación (Municipal Business Operation License)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipio de Panamá — Dirección de Rentas Municipales / Ventanilla Única de Aviso de Operación (or the competent district municipality where the office/warehouse is located).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the 'Aviso de Operación' application declaring the economic activity under ISIC 4661 (wholesale supply of drummed and bagged penetration-grade bitumen and asphalt products), the exact place of business, and the legal representative. Attach the RUC certificate, the Ficha de Persona Jurídica, the fire-safety inspection certificate, the lease or property title, and a sworn declaration of the physical filing. The Municipality will collect the municipal fee (tasa municipal) based on declared capital/activity and issue the annual Aviso de Operación certificate, which must be renewed every January.
required_dossiers: RUC certificate
Ficha de Persona Jurídica and certified articles
Fire-safety inspection certificate from the Cuerpo de Bomberos (for physical storage/office sites)
Lease agreement or title deed for the registered premises
Identity document of the legal representative
Sworn declaration of the economic activity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality suspends the application (for example, pending payment of municipal property taxes by the lessor or an outstanding fire-safety clearance), cure the objection by settling the municipal fee/tax, obtaining the fire-safety certificate, and resubmitting the sealed form; the certificate will then be issued within the ordinary SLA.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting, Organizational Resolutions and Opening of Corporate Bank Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Sociedad Anónima (corporate minutes recorded in the company's Libro de Actas) and the chosen correspondent bank (banking KYC).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting (or adopt unanimous written consent) and pass the pro forma First Board Resolution ratifying the share subscription, adopting the registered office and Resident Agent's address, appointing the President/Secretary/Treasurer, adopting the corporate seal, and authorizing issuance of share certificates. Record the minutes in the 'Libro de Actas y Juntas Directivas' and the share subscription in the 'Registro de Acciones'. For any Panamanian bank account, deliver the corporate kit (certified registered articles, Ficha, RUC, board resolution), the KYC forms and the ultimate beneficial ownership schedule, together with the trade documentation evidencing the bitumen supply contracts and payment flows.
required_dossiers: Signed First Board Resolution (this pro-forma text)
Corporate minutes book and share ledger
Certificate of share subscription and allocation
Corporate kit: certified articles, Ficha de Persona Jurídica, RUC
Resident Agent certificate of appointment
Bank KYC package: passport copies, reference letters, source of funds, ultimate beneficial ownership declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises an 'Enhanced Due Diligence' request for the bitumen supply trade, provide the underlying invoices, purchase orders, the ISIC 4661 activity description, and the municipal Aviso de Operación; if the corporate minutes are returned uncertified, re-execute the resolution before a notary and re-file with the bank.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF); official digital portal: Sede Electrónica de la DGI; auxiliary one-stop corporate/RUC registration window: Panamá Emprende.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Panamanian Sociedad Anónima, the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) is obtained at incorporation through the Panamá Emprende single window. A foreign entity must appoint a resident agent; present apostilled/legalized constitutive documents, a notarized power of attorney, and a local fiscal address; and file the DGI registration forms via Sede Electrónica. Following DGI validation, the RUC is issued and the taxpayer is simultaneously enrolled for income tax (ISR) and ITBMS obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box or passthrough election exists under Panamanian law; the S.A. is always an entity-level territorial taxpayer. Available elections include the annual choice between the general ISR method and the elective Alternative Minimum Tax (ATM at 1% of average net assets), the simplified ITBMS bracket regime for small taxpayers, and, for MNE groups within scope, the OECD Pillar Two global minimum top-up tax treatment effective from 1 January 2025.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (ITBMS) – Panamanian value added tax on imports, transfers of movable goods, and services (Law 6 of 2002, as amended).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: B/.36,000 (Panamanian Balboa at 1:1 parity with USD) of gross taxable turnover in the preceding calendar year; registration is voluntary below the threshold but mandatory once exceeded.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica): every ITBMS-registered taxpayer must issue invoices through DGI-authorized software or the DGI portal, transmitting each invoice in real time to the DGI fiscal clearance server. Invoices must incorporate a QR code, the DGI digital stamp, and an electronic signature; cleared/valid status is required for export documentation and customs purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Containerized drum and bag exports of penetration-grade bitumen qualify for the 0% ITBMS rate when: (i) goods are physically shipped from Panamanian customs territory to a foreign destination under a valid Customs Export Declaration; (ii) the seller holds an active ITBMS registration and transfers title to a non-resident buyer; (iii) payment is received in convertible currency evidenced by banking records; and (iv) the exporter files the corresponding export settlement with DGI. Panama applies no statutory exchange-control repatriation period, but the 180-day evidentiary benchmark applies for banking and DGI review.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación – ANA)
Bill of Lading (clean on-board ocean bill for containerized cargo)
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit confirmation of foreign payment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI may retroactively reassess improperly zero-rated exports within the three-year statutory limitation period (extendable to six years in fraud cases). False zero-rating triggers ITBMS clawback with a 10% late-payment surcharge plus 1% monthly interest, customs fines and forfeiture under Ley 16 de 2016 (Código Aduanero), and criminal tax fraud liability under Ley 8 de 2010 with imprisonment of three to five years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama operates no traditional central bank. The Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) is the banking and financial supervisor under the Decreto de Gabinete No. 9 de 1998 Banking Law (Ley Bancaria, as amended). Banco Nacional de Panamá (BNP) acts as the Republic's fiscal agent, clearing agent, and a state-owned commercial bank. The Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) administers the RUC, the aviso de operación, and the beneficial-owner registry; the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) is the AML/CFT financial intelligence unit.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama operates a fully dollarized monetary regime: the US dollar is legal tender and the Panamanian balboa exists only as a 1:1 coin sub-unit. There are no exchange controls, no FX licensing, no funds import/export restrictions, and no prior authorization for profit remittance. Current-account and capital-account flows are freely convertible in and out. Non-resident shareholders may receive dividends in USD without repatriation hurdles, subject only to the standard Panamanian dividend withholding (5% on profits already taxed at the 25% corporate level; 10% on untaxed and foreign-source profits under the territorial system) and the remitting bank's KYC/OFAC documentary review.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama imposes no statutory repatriation timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no surrender obligation on export receipts. An ISIC 4661 containerized bitumen exporter may retain USD or other convertible currencies indefinitely in any SBP-licensed bank or abroad. The only binding constraints are commercial (proper invoicing of the containerized sale), tax (RUC registration, territorial income declaration, and transfer-pricing documentation where applicable), and AML/CFT (retaining underlying trade documents and correspondent-routing records for UAF inspection).

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / Trade Finance LC Facility
Fiscal Agent Clearing Account / Escrow Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. Pure offshore digital EMIs without an SBP general banking license cannot lawfully intermediate deposits or issue UCP 600 letters of credit for a Panamanian S.A.; the Ley Bancaria requires SBP authorization for financial intermediation, so most UK/EU-style EMI challengers reject Panama-domiciled corporate accounts. SBP-licensed local neobank platforms can be used as a secondary collection rail for customer receivables but are not suited as the primary treasury vehicle for capital escrow, commodity trade settlements, or LC issuance. The recommended structure is a Tier-1 licensed bank as the sole primary account, with fintech rails reserved for small-value working-capital flows.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Practically mandatory for the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) and at least one authorized signatory. Most Tier-1 Panamanian banks require either (a) an in-person interview at a Panamanian branch, or (b) a notarized and apostilled corporate power of attorney in favor of a Panamanian abogado combined with a live video identity-confirmation under Ley 23 de 2015 KYC protocols. Fully remote opening without a local counsel relationship is not market-standard for a non-resident-owned S.A. Under the new Ley 5 de 2020 corporation law, board resolutions must be notarized and registered in the Registro Público; apostilled constitutional documents, a certified extract of the share register, recent financial statements, and a source-of-funds letter are routinely collected.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Commodity-trading sector overlay: bitumen/asphalt wholesale triggers trade-based money-laundering scoring, particularly when cargo routing touches high-scrutiny or sanctioned jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full chain-of-custody package: signed Incoterms sale and purchase contracts, commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading or FCRs, certificate of origin, product specification sheets for penetration-grade bitumen, and OFAC/UN/EU sanctions screening reports on all counterparties, carriers, vessels, and final discharge ports.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital-injection mismatch: sudden USD shareholder deposits inconsistent with the declared RUC economic activity or the submitted business plan.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Capital escrow ledger, board resolution approving the capital call, share subscription or assignment instrument, at least six months of source-of-funds bank statements from the contributing shareholder, and a notarized source-of-wealth letter aligned with the projected bitumen purchase volume.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity or late compliance with the beneficial-owner registry under Ley 129 de 2020.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Declaración de Beneficiarios Finales filed with DGI, Registro Público certificate (Ficha), certified extract of the Libro de Accionistas, and a government-issued passport and proof-of-address for each natural person holding at least 10% voting or economic interest.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Related-party or third-country payment red flags, such as payments through correspondent banks in elevated-risk jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Group org chart evidencing commercial substance, inter-party trade contracts, tax-residence certificates for all related entities, PEP declarations for directors and UBOs, and a written narrative explaining the commercial rationale for each third-country route used in procurement of drummed or bagged bitumen.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route entirely in USD via SWIFT MT103 with the remittance narrative 'Aporte de Capital - Sociedad Anónima' plus the S.A. RUC and Ficha number; Panama has no statutory purpose-code list, so banks rely on a descriptive narrative. Pre-clear the transfer with the receiving Tier-1 bank and lodge the capital escrow instruction, board resolution, share register extract, and UBO declaration. No FX conversion or governmental approval applies because of full dollarization; the receiving bank will perform OFAC and sanctions screening of both originator and beneficiary. Shareholder loans must be supported by a written loan agreement and board minutes to prevent equity-versus-debt reclassification; cash or interposed third-party transfers are prohibited under Ley 23 de 2015.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103/TT through New York correspondents (CHIPS/Fedwire same-day USD) for open-account settlements, freight, storage, and terminal fees. For procurement of drummed or bagged penetration-grade bitumen from overseas refineries, use a Commercial Letter of Credit issued by the Panamanian bank under UCP 600 and ISBP 745, available by sight or usance draft and negotiated through the supplier's confirming bank. Documentary collection (D/P or D/A) is a secondary rail for trusted counterparties. USD is the natural settlement currency; Panama's local clearing house applies only to domestic USD-denominated items, not to cross-border trade, so all international payments must use correspondent-bank rails.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain vanilla deliverable FX forward contracts (USD/EUR, USD/COP) executed through SBP-licensed general-license banks
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on CNY/USD and other restricted currencies where physical delivery is impracticable
Cross-currency swaps (USD/EUR, USD/CNY) for matched procurement and sales cash flows
Vanilla and barrier FX options acquired solely to hedge commercial exposure on bitumen procurement contracts

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance of Panama, payable via Banco Nacional de Panamá
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 31 January of each calendar year for existing SAs; for new incorporations, the full annual fee applies and becomes due per the incorporation-month schedule set by the DGI
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment accrues a 10% monthly surcharge on the unpaid fee, capped at 50%, plus statutory interest; repeated non-payment of the annual franchise tax can lead to suspension of corporate registration and eventual administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración Jurada de Impuesto sobre la Renta (Annual Corporate Income Tax Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 15 March of the following tax year for calendar-year taxpayers, or within three months after the fiscal year-end for fiscal-year taxpayers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs DGI fines of 5% up to 50% of the assessed tax plus monthly interest; outstanding returns also prevent issuance of tax clearance certificates and subject the S.A. to administrative tax liens.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración Anual de Beneficiario Final (Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos – Registro de Beneficiario Final (DGI Beneficial Ownership Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule: within 30 days after the annual beneficial ownership confirmation date maintained by the registered agent, and within 30 days after any direct or indirect shareholding change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or inaccurate UBO filings are subject to fines under Panama Law 129 of 2020 and its regulations; penalties range from USD 1,000 to USD 50,000 per violation, directors may face personal liability, and persistent non-filing can result in registration suspension and loss of the S.A.'s legal standing.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Statutory independent audit is compulsory for Panamanian SAs that are public-interest entities, listed issuers, or taxpayers exceeding the DGI revenue or asset thresholds, commonly applied at annual gross income above USD 3,000,000 or total assets above USD 3,000,000; all other SAs must maintain financial statements in accordance with Panama's accounting framework but are not required to file an audited report unless requested by the DGI.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Panama for larger entities; IFRS for SMEs for small- and medium-sized entities; accounting records in Spanish and ledger entries in recognized standard currency are accepted.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each Panamanian S.A. must file a beneficial owner declaration with the DGI through the authorised registered agent, confirming all direct and indirect beneficial owners, shareholding interests, and any trust or nominee arrangements. The confirmation must be updated within 30 days of any share transfer or ownership change and must be revalidated on the entity's annual DGI calendar window; the registered agent is responsible for maintaining the underlying supporting documentation and resubmitting any changes.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350–USD 800 per year for registered office and resident agent services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500–USD 6,500 per year when audit is required; no audit fee applies for an inactive or non-threshold S.A.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial taxation applies: only Panama-source income is within the corporate income tax net; foreign-source wholesale trading margins from containerized export sales are exempt. Preferential regimes available: Multinational Headquarters (SEM) effective 5% rate, Panama Pacifico and Zona Libre de Colon incentives, and deductions for export logistics costs. No minimum capital requirement and no wealth or capital tax for a standard S.A.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 125 - Declaracion de Renta de Personas Juridicas filed through the DGI online system (Sistema de Declaraciones y Pagos en Linea, e-Tax portal)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months after fiscal year-end; calendar-year filers must file no later than 31 March; companies assigned special fiscal closings by RUC digit follow the DGI fiscal-closing schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total invoiced sales of containerized drummed and bagged bitumen and asphalt products during the fiscal period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only Panama-source gross receipts; retain bills of lading, INCOTERM clauses, and LC documents evidencing the place of sale for offshore transfers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Receipts excluded from taxable income: export sales with title and risk passing outside Panama, free-zone income, and other territorial exemptions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Document the locus of sale; if physical delivery and title transfer occur outside Panama, the margin is foreign-source and must be supported by the sales contract, shipping terms, and payment records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Inventoried CIF cost of bitumen and asphalt products, freight, marine insurance, container handling, and port storage.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Match costs to reported revenue on the same accounting basis; related-party purchases must comply with the transfer-pricing documentation thresholds.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Demurrage, wharfage, surveyor certificates, logistics commissions, storage, and administrative overhead.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments to non-resident service providers must be deductible only if properly documented, economically real, and at arm's length; undocumented cross-border service fees are added back.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 5 - Net taxable income (Renta neta gravable)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Panama-source gross profit less allowed deductions and any loss carryforward limited to five fiscal years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute strictly on a territorial basis; losses generated by foreign branches or foreign-source business are not deductible against Panama-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax at 25% of net taxable income, before prepayments and withholding credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The 25% headline rate applies equally to domestic entities and to non-resident entities operating through a Panama permanent establishment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly advance installments (Formulario 125-I) and third-party withholding taxes credited against the annual liability.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile all e-Tax payment vouchers and bank receipts before submission to avoid double assessment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 8 - Final balance due or credit and transfer-pricing annex
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net tax remittance or refundable credit; mandatory attachment of the transfer-pricing Local File summary when related-party transactions exceed the statutory threshold.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If related-party transactions exceed USD 2,000,000, attach the Local File and complete the annual transfer-pricing annex; non-resident branches must apply the same documentation rules.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing incurs a fine of 10% of the tax due (minimum USD 100). Late payment accrues a monthly surcharge of 1% up to a 25% cap, plus interest at the official rate. Repeat non-filing triggers RUC suspension and loss of the Paz y Salvo certificate, blocking customs clearance and banking operations.
